entries.title: Adding back a removed project uses the folder it left
entries.body: When you remove a project, its folder stays in your projects folder. Adding the same project again, from Settings or by asking your first mate, now uses that folder with its files instead of cloning a second copy whose name ends in -2. Picking that folder in Settings works too. The project comes back with default settings.

picture.alt: Settings shows field-notes added back, saying its folder was still in the projects folder, so that folder is linked instead of cloned again
